notes:
ZND-1e kicker slice, the two TRIGGERED lanes (CR 603.2 over the CAST row).
Roost of Drakes {U}, kicker {2}{U}: (a) ETB trigger gated on WAS_KICKED and
(b) 'whenever you cast a kicked spell, create a 2/2 Drake' with the
CastSpellEvent filter reading the cast row's kicked column. Kicked Roost:
exactly 1 Drake — the ETB fires, and the cast trigger must NOT fire on the
spell that carried Roost itself (CR 603.2: the ability did not exist on the
battlefield when its spell was cast). 2 here would be the always-fires bug.
Kicked Into the Roil (the cast ITSELF is kicked): cast trigger fires -> 2nd
Drake, and the spell's own Conditional(WAS_KICKED) arm draws a card (hand
lane: 3 - 3 casts + 1 draw = 1). Un-kicked Roost: condition False on both
arms -> silent (2 stays, falsifies any always-fires encoding). Mana:
10U - 4U (kicked Roost) - 4U (kicked Roil) - 1U (plain Roost) = 1U.
